notes.title: Chester's Log: Update Two
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/343e5af953c2f3779cf289dba270585352aa5167.gif[/img]

Time for another game development update! This week we are going to showcase the next boss we are building. Let's all say hello to Jackie Jumps. This pissed-off bunny is a whirling tempest of fury. Hot-blooded and quick to anger, this rocket-fueled rodent is a handful.

Before we dive into let me remind everyone that our upcoming [b]Kickstarter Campaign[/b] is [b]Coming Soon[/b]. For more information regarding our Kickstarter, be sure to visit our revamped Kickstarter Landing page. From there you can pre-register for our Kickstarter. Not only is this super helpful for our cause, but It will let you know the [b]instant[/b] our campaign goes [b]LIVE.[/b]

[h2][url=http://www.chestersrevenge.com/kickstarter/]Pre-Register Kickstarter Now![/url][/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/e22b37da33a8939c1555a378b06b7114345e9c68.png[/img]

Only upon the icy cold frozen Tundra of Torment will you find the legendary Jackie Jumps. A whirling tempest of fury, this unstable bunny is hot-blooded and quick to anger. Never piss off the bunny. This rocket-fueled rodent loves to duel and never passes up a good fight. He loves to enter combat with a spear and springboard himself into the sky for devastating aerial maneuvers. This jacked-up rabbit fights like a dragoon on crack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/cc74cbff828d8acc63f423824e537f9476b7707f.gif[/img]

Lots of tender loving care went into the design of Jackie Jumps. We wanted to create an adorable-looking rabbit character, but with the mind of a complete psychopath. This was really fleshed out during VO development. Jackie was brought to life by the incredible Tom Schalk. Overall, we ended up with an incredible character. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/c451e0ec3eb4fbd70bbe578e6c2ca7c2706f4cc1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/bea44914985a85636f8a4ff64493aea4dbe3e2b6.png[/img]


[h2][b]Tundra of Torment[/b][/h2]

Before you can fight him one-on-one though, you have to get through [b]The Tundra of Torment[/b]. This snow-capped hellscape will put your platforming skills to the test. Chester will have to contend with treacherous icy ledges, blizzards, snowmen, and penguins of doom! Just to name a few!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/126d64af2786853de4c0011fd788c623ddcdf2d8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/fa26c7a3e07551db43bfeafda58af89c02bc0397.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/e13540701d7353375e96b2df88c33588f7544303.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/1cbb61888e6553e7a0f8f006a7d5835f8094374f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/7d3fec3e285f0653c6ea3140f6dd440f3698cb4b.png[/img]


[h2][b]Coming Soon[/b][/h2]

We'll have lots more content coming soon showing off more of Jackie Jumps. Including lots of videos and VO. Next time we will take a look at Laser Eye. Another boss we are cooking up. Wait till you get a load of this guy.

In the meantime. Be safe and never piss off the bunny!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/24540d4f94dbf0f0c260b3ee0203d7442aaee37f.png[/img]

notes.title: Chester's Log: Update One
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/96160b46d189668e9a3e598b624ec21b50e461b4.png[/img]

So our Steam Demo is out and Next Fest is over. It's time to move on to the next stage of development. The first major thing we have coming down the pipe is our Kickstarter Campaign. We don't have an exact date yet, but we are shooting for late July or August sometime.

For more information regarding our Kickstarter, be sure to visit our revamped Kickstarter Landing page. From there you can pre-register for our Kickstarter. It will let you know when our campaign goes LIVE.

[h2][url=http://www.chestersrevenge.com/kickstarter/]Pre-Register Kickstarter Now![/url][/h2]


As far as actual game development goes, we are going to be focusing on a few different things over the next few months. One of which is going to be our gunplay in the game. We are listening to feedback and will be looking at different ways to spice up and improve the gunplay. We are floating around a few different ideas to make the gunplay more fun.

[b][h2]Chester Upgrades[/h2][/b]
We are going to be implementing some graphical updates to Chester which will improve the overall look and feel of the core gameplay. Additionally, we are going to be going back through our code and rewriting our player code and collision code to ensure the game is as bug-free as possible for release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/ad884624b395ca2f3cc14a66445cb7c249ec3cc0.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/0beaaad0e612732f8f3f65c4a2648f64cf147515.gif[/img]


[b][h2]Drago Dinn[/h2][/b]
We are also going to be expanding and improving the Drago Dinn experience. We're going to be adding more content to his actual level. By that we mean we are adding a whole other back half to his level for Chester to conquer. Additionally, we are going to be adding more attacks and tweaking the mechanics of his boss encounter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/2afbb2ec2fca61fb0cbf9dd87c25a00643fe69f0.png[/img]


[b][h2]Gunplay[/h2][/b]
We are listening to feedback and will be looking to revamp our gunplay system. As of now, it is pretty basic and one-dimensional. In addition to adding in a Super Shot ability, we will be looking to add a more complex upgrade system to your arm cannon. Some of these ideas include:

[b]Talent Tree[/b] - A basic talent tree that lets you upgrade your gun cannon from points or tokens earned from defeated bosses. 

[b]Mega Man System[/b] - A standard MM-style system where you earn new gun types based after defeating each boss. These new gun types are then used to defeat other bosses.

[b]Contra Style Power-Ups[/b] - A system where power-ups and new gun types are randomly dropped from enemies. They would last until death or until you gained a new power-up. 

[b]Super Shot Variety[/b] - We also like the idea of implementing a system where you can augment and change what your Super Shot does. This could be a combination of a Talent Tree and MM Style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/a3c8cafacec0a55949a118556a5860e203f56bf7.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/c267913352256109e8bc23d97af04a3c81ea59c0.gif[/img]


[h2][b]Jackie Jumps[/b][/h2]
In addition to finishing up Drago Dinn, we will also be moving on to our next major boss, everyone's favorite bunny, Jackie Jumps. We'll be constructing his level "Tundra of Torment" and designing his boss fight fully. We have some fun ideas already planned for his winter wonderland. We're going to have lots more content featuring this pissed-off bunny in the coming months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/ceeea447b26478500a0f00b9fb5b76268464da71.gif[/img]


[b][h2]Laser Eye[/h2][/b]
We also have a super early look at Laser Eye and his level "The Ruins of Wailing". We can't wait to unveil more of this badass metal music-loving super villain. He's got his EYE on you already!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/85438ebd887857b0bbd49695a3bac470a6c286c6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/f2373372f7a73f1efa704b3b11f7c2598b98789e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Kickstarter Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/0198e01a757e9e78bb015787ad497a263fe7a1ea.jpg[/img]

[h1]Our Kickstarter Is Coming Soon[/h1]

Chester’s Revenge needs you! Our Kickstarter is coming soon. Pre-signup now to receive special updates and notifications when our Kickstarter goes live. Don’t miss out on the epic rewards we have planned!

[url=http://www.chestersrevenge.com/kickstarter/]CLICK HERE TO PRE-REGISTER![/url]


[h1]Chester Plushie[/h1]

We have epic early-bird specials and other awesome rewards planned. Including physical copies of the game, a physical hardcover art book, and a limited-time Chester Plushie! Plus all sorts of incredible digital rewards. Registering is free and you will be notified when our campaign goes live. Check out some of our rewards and reward tiers below:

- Limited Edition Official Chester Plushie. We’ll also be offering up a Sting Tooth Plushie as an add-on.
- Physical Copy of the Game for the Console of your choice.
- Hardcover “The Art of Revenge” Art Book.
- Digital and Physical Official Soundtrack.
- Set of Chester’s Revenge Trading Cards.
- Character Art Posters.
- Buttons, Stickers, and Pins.
- Digital Reward: Write your own fully voiced character boss line.
- Digital Reward: Build your own boss and level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/b6ff743dba35921097ea74e284dd7c9c1f1fd3d5.png[/img]


[h1]Multi-Platform Release[/h1]

Bonus Stage Publishing will be releasing Chester’s Revenge on Steam in addition to Nintendo, Sony, and Microsoft home consoles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/542c4c6ab024e9cadaddfc8536351bfaeef58266.png[/img]


[h1]Retro Gameplay[/h1]

Play as Chester, a smart-mouthed guinea pig with an attitude who is hell-bent on a quest for revenge against the murderous Rad Ralph.

- Inspired by modern classics such as Cuphead and traditional classics such as Mega Man, Chester’s Revenge is a retro-style 2d Shooter with a strong design emphasis on precision platforming, intense combat, and epic boss fights. 
- Claim your revenge and crush eight epic bosses across eight kickass platformer levels.
- Chester’s Revenge was built using traditional 2d pixel art. We wanted to create a look and feel that comes right out of the SNES era.
- Rock out to an epic 8-bit Chiptune Tradtionial Soundtrack that will melt your face off and take you right back to the ’80s.
- Every boss character is fully voiced and has its own unique character and backstory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/2eedc4cd3485cc8641b1e071b32975628eef0ea6.png[/img]


[h1]Eight Planned Bosses[/h1]

Blast your way through eight epic bosses on your quest to retrieve the Sacred Carrot and claim your vengeance! Take them down one by one in any order you choose. Chester’s Revenge is presented in a non-linear fashion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/d71278e2ec51dc9f3a7c0ec54d170df1985122e6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/ec9c73386c881022d87c7d655ad86974e29f5383.png[/img]


[h1]Beautiful Artwork[/h1]

All of the artwork in Chester’s Revenge is expertly and professionally made by a team of amazing artists. Each and every character goes from concept to illustration to pixel art.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/3c78a691fdbfde83abee9d46a97194146aa05ad5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/8600d0fa4fa7d0fa7159080755143d2351612d88.png[/img]


[h1]Pre-Register For Kickstarter Today[/h1]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chestersrevenge/chesters-revenge]CLICK HERE TO PRE-REGISTER![/url]

Take control of Chester the pig as you avenge your herd and set out to retrieve the Sacred Carrot. Armed only with his trusty hand cannon, Chester must battle his way through Rad Ralph’s lieutenants in an over-the-top style revenge romp to reclaim the Carrot and stop Rad Ralph from world domination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/5b538e9e6cb04ca03046e6f4bee2bf6368720a45.png[/img]

notes.title: Chester's Revenge Live Stream Event
notes.content:
[h1]Join the creative mind behind Chester's Revenge for a LIVE developer playthrough[/h1]

Take control of Chester the pig as you avenge your herd and set out to retrieve the stolen Sacred Carrot. Chester’s Revenge is a heart-pumping, fast-paced 2d action game inspired by old and modern classics such as Cuphead, Mega Man, and Metal Slug.

The Steam Demo goes LIVE on June 13th at 10 AM (PT) and features two epic levels and bosses to battle and conquer. Battle through both Mount Inferno and The Desert of Death.


[h1]Sting Tooth[/h1]

Whereas he may be the weakest of Rad Ralph's lieutenants, this ancient manticore still packs a lethal sting. Sting Tooth loves to taunt his prey and will talk up a big game before closing in for the kill. He resides within the blistering dunes of the Desert of Death. Sting Tooth will destroy his foes with neverending volleys of lethal stingers and a fiery breath assault that turns flesh into ash.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/e9afde427bfdfdb4504c2c309caf6b9ffa155fcb.png[/img]


[h1]Drago Dinn[/h1]

When it comes to sword fighting, there is no one better than Drago Dinn. So refined are his skills with the blade, that he refers to it as dancing. Residing in the flaming belly of Mount Inferno, this sophisticated snake loves company and dueling. Nothing gets his cold blood boiling more than a good old-fashioned dance-off. Nobody puts Drago in a corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625383/c68f5651d70e4b1332572a81b64bb35160efb359.png[/img]

notes.title: Triple Take is a game of the saying “third time’s the charm” – but the third time might just cause some rage quits this time
notes.content:
Finland biggest publisher Bonus Stage Publishing (That's us, yey) today announced Triple Take: a game by FlyAway found its way to their portfolio. The game will be released in 2022. 

The demo is already available on Steam.  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734250

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37611909/cf3eddeeff2922ebb1d02fc717e994d92a883a17.gif[/img]

Triple Take is a series of unexpected experiences in the form of a fast 2D precision platformer where the level evolves as you complete it! Run, wall jump, climb and swim through increasingly difficult levels in (un)vibrantly colored worlds! 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37611909/ba6e8606ffab44e3c9d11140963f44d7e722b7c8.jpg[/img]

When you start any level for the first time, it might seem to be almost too easy to beat, but the levels evolve when you play further. Every time you beat any level, the level changes somehow and you need to play it again. Three times. Triple Take. Ok, you got it. This makes completing levels… difficult. Jumps become more difficult, new threats reveal themselves, and new pathways open up! Difficult.

notes.title: Chester's Revenge is announced by Bonus Stage Publishing and develop
notes.content:
[b]Chester the Guinea Pig Is After Revenge
[/b]

Power corrupts. Sacred carrot corrupts. Rad Ralph stole the Sacred carrot and now it is up to Chester to revenge and get the Sacred carrot back. The backstory for this retrotastic platformer is epic indeed. Chester's Revenge (2022/2023) is announced by Bonus Stage Publishing and developed by Wojo Studios.

[previewyoutube=V6D2M0Oc3kA;full][/previewyoutube]


Bonus Stage Publishing is announcing Chester's Revenge to be released in late 2022/early 2023. Chester's Revenge is a retrotastic platformer about an adventure of Chester, a guinea pig who is looking for revenge. Rad Ralph was a beautiful guinea pig himself, and one day he stole the herd's Sacred Carrot and it turned him into a foul creature leading evil minions.

[img]https://prowly-uploads.s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/uploads/landing_page/template_background/168104/5bf373d79998f8e344a5e729a71bce28.jpg[/img]

Chester's Revenge is being developed by Wojo Studios. The title is inspired by real-life events and characters. One of the pigs living with Wojo's founder is Chester, although his carrots are all sacred and none of them have been stolen. Or at least this Chester is very secretive about his missions of revenge if he has been on one...

So get ready for Chester's Revenge! See, wishlist and follow the game on Steam here. The game has a closed beta coming up in early 2022, so follow up closely and join the adventures early on.

Wishlist Chester's Revenge now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1739620/Chesters_Revenge/
